The employer 17.5% is 3% sickness and maternity, 14% retirement and survivorship, and 0.5% occupational accident and disease under the Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.44 with Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4. Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,340,000 đ on this version). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Above the ceiling (twenty times the reference level) the employer’s share is the ceiling at the employer’s own rate — 17.3% where the occupational-accident fund is reduced (Decree 58/2020 art.4), 17.5% otherwise — the same choice the open rungs make. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): The base recorded is the insurance salary itself — the contractual salary floored at the reference level (2340000.0) and capped at twenty times it (46800000.0) — so a scheme that reads `produced.SI.base` reads the insured salary. Unpaid-leave continuation: Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5) and 34(3) permit continuation by agreement at the most recent contribution base; art.31(1)(đ) sets the bounds at contribution time. The dated registration records the agreement, reference and prior base. authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.33 and art.34 — 8% employee and 17.5% employer, on a salary capped at 20 times the statutory reference level (2,530,000, ceiling 50,600,000). Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). Applied 2026-09-18: an employer granted the reduced 0.3% occupational-accident rate (Decree 58/2020 art.5) records the entity fact `occupational_accident_reduced`; its share is then 17.3%. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(1)–(2): the insurance salary is the contractual salary plus the contractual allowances and fixed supplements (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a meal, fuel, phone or housing allowance is a row marked not fixed and stays outside. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Above the ceiling (twenty times the reference level) the employer’s share is the ceiling at the employer’s own rate — 17.3% where the occupational-accident fund is reduced (Decree 58/2020 art.4), 17.5% otherwise — the same choice the open rungs make. Applied 2026-09-19 (3): The base recorded is the insurance salary itself — the contractual salary floored at the reference level (2530000.0) and capped at twenty times it (50600000.0) — so a scheme that reads `produced.SI.base` reads the insured salary. name: Personal Income Tax (Thuế thu nhập cá nhân)
authority: Personal Income Tax Law 04/2007/QH12 and Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC; Law 109/2025/QH15 and Decree 253/2026/ND-CP for the 2026 rules. Declared non-residents receive 20% withholding on taxable remuneration without resident personal, dependant or insurance deductions; that rule precedes the resident short-contract withholding rule and does not require a rate override. Resident progressive withholding uses the version’s monthly scale and deduction amounts; the configured year-end rule reconciles annual withholding. Before 1 July 2026, non-residents retain the earlier overtime-premium exemption and taxable leave cash-out. The full qualifying overtime and statutory cessation leave exemptions apply to residents from tax year 2026 and non-residents from 1 July 2026 (Decree 253/2026 arts.26 and 69). A future departure does not establish cessation in the current period. Payments beyond statutory limits remain taxable. Unknown tax residence, special tax profiles and exemption allocation require further verification.
